title: ReproCrowd FLoRA import record
description: A record that maps a ReproCrowd certificate into the FLoRA reproduction list, tagged as an AI-generated numerical/computational reproduction (outcome_robustness = not checked).

ai_generated.description: FLoRA AI-generated tag. true = produced by an LLM coding agent.

method.description: e.g. 'LLM coding agent (Claude Opus 4.7), ReproCrowd rule pack v1.0.0'.

repro_standard_version.description: The ReproCrowd / ReproAI standard used, e.g. 'crowd-repro v1.0.0' or the ReproAI rules date '2026.06.27'.

engine.description: The engine that ran the reprocheck, e.g. 'anomalyco/opencode — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT'.

programs.description: Full program inventory: every interpreter, its version, its packages, and the lockfile.

lockfile.description: Path or identifier of the pinned lockfile, e.g. 'renv.lock'.

github_url.description: URL of the GitHub repo where the certificate and artifacts are published. Maps to FLoRA url_r.

ref_o.description: Original paper, APA with DOI. FLoRA column ref_o.

study_o.description: The specific claim/study being reproduced. FLoRA column study_o.

ref_r.description: The reproduction report, APA with DOI. FLoRA column ref_r.

doi_r.description: Optional Zenodo DOI of the reproduction. FLoRA column doi_r.

url_r.description: The stable report URL (the GitHub URL). FLoRA column url_r.

abstract_r.description: Reproduction abstract (not published in the FLoRA dataset). FLoRA column abstract_r.

outcome_computational_quote.description: Quote describing the computational outcome. FLoRA column outcome_computational_quote.

out_quote_computational_source.description: Location of that quote, e.g. 'abstract', 'p. 4'. FLoRA column out_quote_computational_source.

outcome_robustness.description: Always 'not checked' — a ReproCrowd certificate does not test robustness.

alt_identifier_r.description: Optional alternative identifier for the reproduction. FLoRA column alt_identifier_r.
